propositions: The per-event equivalence oracle in the fixture calls resolve_event_commit exactly once and returns None on transient Git failures (rc128, rc0/empty, BlockingIOError), while the batched resolver recovers, causing equivalence assertions to fail.

A test-local bounded helper function (_fixture_per_event_commit) must retry the per-event resolve_event_commit up to five times for exact transient recovery equivalence, mirroring the batched fixture's existing retry behavior.
Production resolve_event_commit must remain fail-closed and unchanged; all transient recovery logic must be confined to the test fixture, not added to src/rebar production code.
Persistent per-event failures after five attempts must stop and raise diagnostics with object-store forensics (fsck, count-objects evidence) rather than silently returning None.
